templates.name: comfyfed-wuxia-t2i
templates.title: 文生圖（Chroma）/ Text-to-image (Chroma)
templates.description: Chroma1-HD text-to-image, 768x768 at 26 steps, uncensored weights. Type your idea in Chinese (or English) into the red node; a local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English prompt and feeds it straight into the graph. Press Run.

templates.name: comfyfed-qwen-t2i
templates.title: 文生圖（Qwen）/ Text-to-image (Qwen)
templates.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image, 1024x1024 at 25 steps, CFG 1 (the official settings). Ships with the same Chinese idea box and the same default idea as the Chroma template, so you can run both and compare the two models side by side; the local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English prompt. Needs ComfyUI 0.37+ on the worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-character-portrait
templates.title: 角色立繪 / Character portrait
templates.description: Chroma1-HD character reference sheet, 896x1152 at 26 steps, uncensored weights. Describe the character in Chinese in the red idea node; the local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the reference-sheet English prompt. Feed its output into the reference-to-video template.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-upscale
templates.title: 圖片放大 / Image upscale
templates.description: 4x super-resolution upscale of a still image via RealESRGAN. Ships with a sample image.

templates.name: comfyfed-ref2v-video
templates.title: 參考圖生影片 / Reference to video
templates.description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video with audio, 1152x640, 141 frames at 8 steps via the turbo LoRA. Ships with a reference image. Describe the shot in Chinese (or English); a local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English prompt, adds the <Picture 1> tag and feeds it in.

templates.name: comfyfed-nsfw-i2v
templates.title: NSFW 圖生影片 / NSFW image-to-video
templates.description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video with audio, fully uncensored: one photo of an adult plus an explicit scene written in Chinese (or English). A local Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English prompt and adds the <Picture 1> tag. 1152x640, 141 frames, 8 steps via the turbo LoRA. Promoted from the admin's shared "(NSFW)圖生影片" template; ships with its sample photo.

templates.name: comfyfed-flf2v-video
templates.title: 首尾幀生影片 / First+last frame to video
templates.description: Give MiniMax H3 a first frame and a last frame, then describe the motion in Chinese in the red idea node; the local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English prompt (with the <Picture 1> tag) and H3 generates the motion and audio in between.

templates.name: comfyfed-video-concat
templates.title: 多影片串接 / Video concat
templates.description: Join two video clips end-to-end, picture and audio both concatenated. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-intro-video
templates.title: 圖片開場＋影片 / Image intro + video
templates.description: Hold one still image for a few seconds as a title card, then play a video clip. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-video-trim
templates.title: 影片截段 / Video trim
templates.description: Cut a start-second + length span out of a video clip. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-acestep-music
templates.title: 文生音樂 / Text-to-music
templates.description: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo text-to-music: describe the song in Chinese, write Chinese lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] markers, pick a length in seconds, press Run. The local uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the English style tags; one MIT-licensed 10 GB all-in-one checkpoint covers model, text encoder and VAE.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-to-prompt
templates.title: 圖生提示詞 / Image to prompt
templates.description: Upload a reference image and a short ask; a local, uncensored Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic model writes the polished English prompt for you — it will not refuse an explicit one. Ships with a sample image.
